claim: controlled real-RGB iterative measured CAD grammar; object 2 remains a provisional ACCEPT and object 4 improves geometrically but remains ABSTAIN

architecture_change.learned_policy_role: propose a restricted CADENA construction root
architecture_change.measured_feature_role: iteratively fit bounded axial revolved additions or subtractions from signed target-surface residuals after each kernel-valid root/rewrite
beam_candidates: a second residual-refitted measured operation when still supported
architecture_change.selection: minimum profile complexity; source-view score within 0.001; then fewer and more conservative measured operations
architecture_change.provenance_chain: learned proposal -> exact profile rewrite -> measured boolean operation, with relationship and full kernel validation stored at every accepted node
architecture_change.source_view_edges: smooth-face group boundaries; tessellation seams within 15 degrees are ignored

renderer.reason: remove one-pixel off-screen VTK raster jitter without coarsening measured verification renders

evaluator.alignment: independent bbox centering and largest-extent normalization; no ICP or per-axis scaling
evaluator.step_cleanup: remove exact zero-area OCC seam triangles only; no hole filling or geometry repair
evaluator.reference_access: post-hoc after program and ACCEPT/ABSTAIN decision were frozen

v4_measured_topology.selected_branch: revolve-proxy root plus conservative measured axial-revolved-cut
v4_measured_topology.visual_audit: the axial cavity is present and the macro envelope is coherent; external thread, knurl and scalloped detail remain smoothed and are not claimed as recovered
v4_measured_topology.product_reason: the measured cavity closes the internal-topology gate on 32 source views; this is a provisional controlled-case acceptance, not category-level validation

v5_iterative_measured_grammar.selected_branch: revolve-proxy root -> profile rewrite -> conservative measured axial-revolved-cut
v5_iterative_measured_grammar.visual_audit: the axial cavity is present and the macro envelope is coherent; external thread, knurl and scalloped detail remain smoothed and are not claimed as recovered
v5_iterative_measured_grammar.product_reason: the measured cavity passes the kernel and 32-source-view topology gates; the negligible IoU trade-off accompanies slightly better Chamfer and one fewer analytic face

v4_measured_topology.selected_branch: measured-target root without unsupported axial cut
v4_measured_topology.visual_audit: the smooth main envelope is present, but small terminals and thread-like external details remain absent
v4_measured_topology.product_reason: the measured feature gates reject unsupported subtraction and the source-view topology gate preserves ABSTAIN

v5_iterative_measured_grammar.selected_branch: measured-target root -> profile rewrite -> conservative measured axial-revolved-add
v5_iterative_measured_grammar.visual_audit: the previously missing lower axial extension is now present and the macro silhouette is much closer; the top pin and lower terminal flange are still absent
v5_iterative_measured_grammar.product_reason: macro geometry improves strongly without reference access, but unexplained source-image edges keep the product decision at ABSTAIN

test_gate.gpu_tests: skipped by marker/environment in the repository gate; the two controlled fits ran separately on RTX 5080

conclusion: A bounded signed-residual CAD grammar now composes learned revolve roots with measured add/cut operations and exact per-prefix provenance. It preserves the object-2 cavity and raises object-4 post-hoc IoU from 0.5585 to 0.7400 while correctly retaining ABSTAIN. Two controlled objects validate the mechanism, not universal generalization or SOTA.
da3_role: optional experimental confidence-aware prior; unused in these calibrated dense runs
